tell_me_about_yourself.answer: I am a B.Tech student in Computer Science and Business Systems at Heritage Institute of Technology. I have hands-on experience developing full-stack web applications using the MERN stack. I have built projects including an e-commerce platform and a business web application, working with technologies such as React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT and Cloudinary. I have also worked on an AI-powered chatbot for my e-commerce project. Along with development, I have solved 150+ DSA problems and achieved the HackerRank SQL Gold Badge.

what_are_your_technical_skills.answer: My technical skills include Java, JavaScript and SQL. For frontend development I use HTML5, CSS3, React.js and Tailwind CSS. For backend development I have worked with Node.js and Express.js, and I use MongoDB for databases. I am also familiar with Git, GitHub, REST APIs, JWT, Vercel, Render and Cloudinary.

tell_me_about_your_projects.answer: I have built three full-stack projects. Ashmir Mocktails is a MERN business web application with an admin dashboard, authentication, CRUD management and Cloudinary-based image management. Al-Ansar Stores is a full-stack e-commerce platform with authentication, product search, cart, checkout, order tracking, an admin dashboard and an AI-powered chatbot called Ansari. Thread Store is a responsive business website with category-based product listings and admin product management.

tell_me_about_your_ecommerce_project.answer: Al-Ansar Stores is a full-stack e-commerce application built using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js and Node.js. It includes Email OTP authentication, JWT-based authorization, product search, cart, checkout and order tracking. I also implemented an AI-powered chatbot called Ansari to assist customers with product recommendations and information about dry fruit health benefits. The project also includes an admin dashboard for products, inventory, users and orders.

what_is_your_educational_background.answer: I am pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science and Business Systems from Heritage Institute of Technology from 2023 to 2027. My CGPA is 7.98 out of 10 up to the 6th semester.

how_many_dsa_problems_have_you_solved.answer: I have solved 150+ Data Structures and Algorithms problems across LeetCode and GeeksforGeeks.

do_you_have_experience_with_ai.answer: I have worked with an AI-powered chatbot called Ansari in my Al-Ansar Stores e-commerce project. The chatbot assists customers with product recommendations and information about dry fruit health benefits.
